question: The driving mechanism of the slotting machine converts the rotary motion of the bull gear into the _______motion of the ram.
solution:
The correct answer is __reciprocating.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The slotting machine__ is a type of reciprocating machine tool.
 
• The rotary motion of the bull gear is converted into the reciprocating motion of the ram.
 
• The ram carries the cutting tool and moves vertically in a straight line.
 
• This mechanism is achieved using a crank and slotted link mechanism.
 
• Slotting machines are used for cutting keyways, grooves, and internal splines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Crank and Slotted Link Mechanism:**

 
 
• This mechanism is commonly used in slotting and shaping machines.
 
• It converts rotary motion into reciprocating motion.
 
 
 
• **Applications of Slotting Machines:**
 
 
• Used for machining internal and external surfaces.
 
• Commonly employed for shaping and grooving tasks.
